Definition: Hodijah, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hodijah = "my majesty is Jehovah"; 1) a Levite in the time of Ezra and Nehemiah; 2) another Levite at the same time; 3) a chief of the people at the same time
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
